source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD)

sections.heading: Scheme Purpose and Eligible Sectors
sections.content: AHIDF is a Rs. 29,610 Crore infrastructure fund established under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan. It incentivizes private entrepreneurs, FPOs, MSMEs, Section 8 companies, and cooperatives to set up: (1) Dairy processing and value addition infrastructure, (2) Meat processing and value addition facilities, (3) Animal feed manufacturing plants, (4) Breed improvement and multiplication farms, and (5) Veterinary vaccine & medicine manufacturing units.

sections.heading: Financial Incentives and Interest Subvention
sections.content: Beneficiaries receive an interest subvention of 3% per annum for up to 8 years on bank loans. Additionally, a credit guarantee of up to 25% of the total loan amount is provided to scheduled banks through the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Animal Husbandry.

sections.heading: Loan Quantum and Repayment Terms
sections.content: Scheduled commercial banks can fund up to 90% of the total project cost. The promoter contribution is minimum 10% for Micro/Small units and 15% for medium units. The loan repayment period is up to 8 years including a moratorium of up to 2 years on the principal amount.
